vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin:
Etymology tree
Middle Persian handʾc- (handāz-)bor.
Middle Persian hndʾhtn' (handāxtan)bor.
Middle Persian hndʾck' (handāzag)bor.
Arabic هَنْدَسَة (handasa)
Arabic مهندس
From the root ه ن د س (h n d s), from هَنْدَسَة (handasa, “geometry, architecture, engineering”), from earlier هَنْدَزَة (handaza), from هَنْدَاز (handāz), borrowed from Middle Persian handʾc- (handāz-), hndʾhtn' (handāxtan, “to plan, allot, reckon, judge”), or hndʾck' (handāzag, “measure, manner”) (> Persian اندازه (andâza)). Has the form of a noun derived from the active participle.
From the root ه ن د س (h n d s), see it for more.
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

From earlier هَنْدَزَة (handaza), from هَنْدَاز (handāz), borrowed from Middle Persian handʾc- (handāz-), hndʾhtn' (handāxtan, “to plan, to allot, to reckon, to judge”), or hndʾck' (handāzag, “measure, manner”) (whence Persian اندازه (andâza)).

Etymology tree
Arabic هَنْدَسَة (handasa)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic هندسي
From هَنْدَسَة (handasa) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
